task_description: Fix bugs that may cause crashes or failing tests.

issues.description: Off-by-one error in calculate_average: loop range is len(numbers) + 1, causing IndexError when accessing numbers[len(numbers)]
calculate_average crashes on empty list: division by zero when len(numbers) == 0
get_element ignores the index parameter and always accesses index + 1
normalize crashes when find_max returns None (empty list): TypeError when dividing by None
find_max returns None for empty list, causing downstream failures in normalize
main() calls all functions with empty list, triggering multiple bugs

patches.notes: Fixed 5 bugs: (1) Off-by-one error in calculate_average loop range, (2) Division by zero handling in calculate_average for empty list, (3) get_element now uses correct index without +1, (4) normalize handles None max_val from empty list, (5) find_max now checks empty list upfront. All fixes are minimal and targeted to the described issues without introducing unrelated refactors.

Fixes off-by-one error in calculate_average, division by zero on empty list, handles None return from find_max in normalize, and corrects index offset in get_element. Main function remains unchanged to test all functions including edge cases.

Fixes all identified bugs: 1) corrects loop range in calculate_average, 2) adds empty list check in calculate_average, 3) fixes get_element to use correct index, 4) adds None check in normalize for empty list handling
